title: PreparedCompositionCommitmentV1
description: LLP 0413.001 §3.3 (r7) / ibex 0056 §3.2 — the digest-only host-held commitment record, delivered on the boot-configuration channel independent of artifact storage; no envelope fact duplicated (declaration, target, producer identity, freshness all live in the envelope, authenticated by this digest). workflow is 'production' per the LLP 0042 production-SHAPED-record rule; the dev posture lives in the entry type. Channel-level prechecks (strict JSON, canonical JCS, schema, workflow) refuse with IBEX_DEV_COMPOSITION_CORRUPT/_SCHEMA/_ARMED_CONTEXT — channel failures OUTSIDE the §4.1 registry (ibex 0056 §8 channel-error variant). The 0056 §3.2 block is provisional pending O-1: this file is the authority it awaits.
